processing: Isolated full-body reference with clean cream hoodie, 1.72m normalized height, grounded toes, 55K triangle web mesh, 2K base color and no grainy normal map
behavior: Animated punch and return with formation and reduced-motion support
limitations: Locally weighted arm rig on inferred geometry; not motion capture. Verified with Blender renders and sampled animated geometry.

animation.method: Local shoulder, elbow and wrist rig; guard, extension and return. Bag recoil synchronized to mixer time.

faceRevision: Intact boxing head turned 43 degrees toward the bag through a blended neck transition, rigid throughout punching. Reader-matched warm skin tone applied at runtime. Direct reader-head replacement was not used.
faceRigFix: Compute arm weights from the original unturned mesh, then retain them after the head turn. Prevents lower jaw receiving upper-arm weights. Regression samples now include all vertices above 1.445m throughout 61 frames, not only the upper head.
